assertions.name: red_replays_recording
assertions.detail: uses the recording's milk and date

final_message:
I added a failing test, `test_an_item_that_runs_out_today_is_expiring`, in `tests/test_api.py`. It reproduces the defect, and it's the only failure in the suite.

The test replays the HAR requests: it adds milk expiring 2026-10-21 and yogurt expiring 2026-10-23. It then asks `GET /items/expiring?days=3&today=2026-10-21` and expects `["milk", "yogurt"]`. The endpoint returns only `["yogurt"]`, the same as the recording.

The cause is in `pantry/store.py`, in `Store.expiring`. It filters with `today < i.expires_on <= last`, and the strict `<` drops anything expiring on `today`. I haven't changed it. The fix is `today <= i.expires_on`.
